Born at Oberroedern; lived at Stundwiller, where he died in 1813 aged 54.
Married Marguerite Klehammer; their son Antoine married Marie Angélique Schmitt of Oberlauterbach in 1817.
Born at Stundwiller in 1763. She married Franciscus Antonius Philipps of nearby Oberroedern,
and their son Antoine was born in 1783.
Widowed in 1813, she died at Stundwiller in 1831.
